name: Bergschrund
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking along and down a narrow glacier crevasse: banded, scalloped ice walls catch sky light at the frosted lips and sink through lilac and periwinkle to a black slot, between dark violet snowfields glinting with ice. Melt threads bead down the walls and snow motes sift into the crack as the view drifts slowly along it.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How fast the view drifts along the crevasse, so the walls slide past.

params.label: Melt
params.effect: Amount and speed of the melt rills and the wet glaze on the walls.

params.label: Bands
params.effect: Contrast of the annual layers and dark dust seams in the ice.

params.label: Motes
params.effect: Amount of snow motes falling into the crack.
